note: Product floors and finish targets read by tools/product-check.mjs (owner 2026-10-11). A broken floor files a bug: packet by itself; a target is the finish line the board climbs toward (docs/FOCUS.md Now). Raise targets when they are met; never lower a floor to make a check green. view_* floors read the `arena view:` line: every drawn body as numbers from the CPU skin, no image (crates/game/src/view_truth.rs).

targets.fps_p50: 60 at 1080p on the RTX 3050 (FC3 asks 30 first)

targets.look_score: machine look score vs references (LJ1, EG30) at or above the bar Q1 sets
targets.pops: 0 joint pops per 300 frames (view line `pops`; LF9 took the attack and idle clip switches to 0; 20-37 remain in a 4-fighter duel, all in the run act, from the run clip speed scale jumping the clip phase)
targets.sunk_cm: under 2 cm (dead bodies rest on the sand at 0 cm since LF17; living bodies still dip 5-14 cm into it at clip crossfades and the run stride: LF9, LF12)
